meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 用户要求用大白话解释技术内容时，Claude 会按 Who、What、Where、Why、When 五问拆解，给出通俗易懂的说明。
howto.when: 当用户说“太技术了，给我讲明白”或要求通俗解释某个技术概念时触发；也可用于追问某事物的来龙去脉（如谁、什么、哪里等）。

say.text: 用大白话给我讲讲什么是 API。
say.note: Claude 会用五问方式解释 API。

say.text: 我不懂区块链，用谁、什么、哪里、为何、何时说清楚。
say.note: Claude 会按五问拆解区块链。

say.text: 这段报错太技术了，帮我解释一下。
say.note: Claude 会通俗说明报错涉及的各方和时机。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for a plain-English explanation of something technical, Claude breaks it down into the five Ws: who, what, where, why, and when, and answers in everyday language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says a topic sounds too technical and wants it explained simply, or asks for the who/what/where/why/when of something.

say_en.text: Explain what an API is in plain English.
say_en.note: Claude answers with the five Ws.

say_en.text: I don't get blockchain. Explain it using who, what, where, why, when.
This error message is too technical. Explain it to me.
